Application Data.NAME: Colorful Interiors, Inc.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Brush St, Suite 100, Color City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Colorful Interiors, Inc. is a retail store specializing in a wide range of paints, wallpapers, and related interior design products. Our operations include selling high-quality paint and wallpaper, offering customization services for special orders, and providing expert advice to customers regarding color selection and interior design techniques. We maintain a secure inventory management system to minimize theft risk and ensure proper storage of all products. Additionally, we adhere to local safety codes and have implemented measures to prevent environmental hazards related to our paint and chemical products. Our commitment to customer satisfaction and safety is reflected in our well-maintained premises and knowledgeable staff, fostering a positive shopping experience for our clients.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a water leak from a faulty roof caused damage to a section of the store, resulting in inventory loss estimated at $2,500. The claim was reported immediately, and remediation efforts were completed promptly. The status of the claim is closed, and the total amount recovered from the insurance was $2,500.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security system with cameras and 24-hour monitoring; trained staff for inventory control and theft prevention.
